name: Cultivation of Immortals
desc:
🌌 Ascend Beyond Mortality! 🌌
Harness your Dao, refine your Qi, and rise through the heavens to carve your name as the Strongest Immortal in existence. Will you master the path… or be forgotten in the dust?

⚔️ -- Game is in Beta Release -- ⚔️

🎁 Codes 🎁
Join the Discord Server to get codes!

🎮 Controls for PC🎮

Fly → F

Attack → Left Mouse Button 

Dash → Q 

Sprint → Double Press W

📱 Mobile → On-Screen Buttons
